| G.AWPN-T91 | 2026-10-18 | fix | closed | Tentacle Cannon dealt zero damage: it's the only gun built on a ShotgunRanged archetype, and GTFO's Shotgun-class pellet path hands weaponRayData.damage back as 0 for it (the same pellet path that already loses the hit's owner, per the existing fallback comment) - read the configured TentacleDamage value directly instead of trusting that field.
